scheme_name: Green Building Rating System (GRIHA) Certification Support
overview: GRIHA (Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment) is India’s national rating system for green buildings, developed by TERI and adopted by the Government of India in 2007. It evaluates buildings based on nationally acceptable benchmarks for energy, water, waste, and sustainability. The GRIHA Council, an autonomous not-for-profit society, promotes and administers the rating system to advance sustainable habitats in India.
objectives: Promote sustainable building practices across India
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions through energy-efficient designs
Encourage water conservation and waste management in construction
Enhance market recognition and credibility of green buildings
Support government climate commitments under UNFCCC and NDC
Build capacity through trainings, workshops, and outreach programs
Provide a framework for assessing environmental performance of buildings
Foster collaboration among policymakers, industry, and academia
eligibility: Eligibility varies by GRIHA variant: For GRIHA Rating, residential projects require >5,000 sq.m built-up area with ≥80% residential use; non-residential requires >2,500 sq.more than 2,500 sq.m. For SVAGRIHA, residential projects range from 100–5,000 sq.m and non-residential from 100–2,500 sq.m. GRIHA for Existing Buildings (EB) requires operational buildings with >1 year of continuous operations data. GRIHA for Affordable Housing aligns with PMAY norms. All projects must exclude parking, basements, and service rooms from built-up area calculations.
benefits: Benefits include reduced energy and water consumption, lower operational costs, enhanced asset value, faster government approvals, eligibility for incentives like extra FAR and tax rebates, improved marketability, recognition in government tenders, access to GRIHA Product Catalogue, networking opportunities, and contribution to national sustainability goals. Certified projects gain visibility on GRIHA website, endorsement to use GRIHA logo, and inclusion in quarterly newsletters.
financial_support: GRIHA is a rating and certification system, not a direct financial subsidy scheme. Financial support comes indirectly through government incentives such as additional FAR (Floor Area Ratio), fast-track approvals, and tax rebates offered by state and central authorities for GRIHA-rated projects. For example, Punjab provides up to 10% additional FAR free of cost for 5-star GRIHA-rated buildings, along with 100% exemption from building scrutiny fees. Maharashtra and other states have similar policies. The GRIHA Council does not disburse grants or loans but enables access to fiscal benefits via certification.
application_process: 1. Register the project on the GRIHA website and select the appropriate rating variant. 2. Pay the registration fee (varies by project type and size). 3. Attend an orientation workshop (optional but recommended). 4. Submit required documents including design drawings, compliance reports, and calculations. 5. Undergo preliminary evaluation by GRIHA Council. 6. Conduct mandatory site visit(s). 7. Submit final documentation. 8. Undergo final evaluation. 9. Receive award of rating upon successful compliance. 10. Optionally appeal for re-evaluation if needed.
required_documents: Bill of quantities and material specifications
Photographs of site and construction progress
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications accepted throughout the year.
implementing_agency: GRIHA Council (an autonomous, not for profit society)
caveats: Rating is subject to fulfilment of all GRIHA document requirements
Fees are non-refundable and must be paid upfront
Government taxes (GST) are applicable on top of base fees
Travel, accommodation, and logistics for GRIHA Council professionals must be arranged by the client
Fast-track process does not guarantee certification if compliance requirements are not met
Incomplete submissions will not be accepted for processing
Certification fee applies if product is enlisted in multiple typologies
Fast-track review fees are additional to registration and certification fees
